machine_contract: R11-F07 — create-only DSD source truth; no runtime, no output claims
seal_212: isolated GStreamer elementary-stream probe (typefind/demux caps observation)
conflict: The machine-readable F07 contract permits pure static source truth while normative §212 describes a GStreamer elementary-stream probe; GST_LIFECYCLE_GATE is BLOCKED, so the probe cannot be implemented or proven now.

resolution.F07_CORE: The deterministic static DSF/DFF parser is the authoritative SOURCE truth for the container and elementary layers wherever structural bytes suffice; it proves container facts, DSD encoding, exact bit rate, packing, bit order, channel organization and layout.
resolution.F07_RUNTIME_PROBE: DEFERRED_GST_LIFECYCLE — the §212 isolated runtime probe is NOT claimed by F07 and must not be simulated, stubbed or approximated by the static parser.
resolution.F08_RULE: AP2-F08 (Native DSD runtime) must not assume that runtime elementary-stream probe evidence exists. Runtime branch availability, gst caps evidence and decoded facts remain unproven until a runtime phase performs the isolated probe under a working lifecycle gate.
resolution.no_capability_promotion: Static parser evidence never proves Native DSD route availability, DoP framing, DAC capability, bit-perfect output or current-device support.

precedence_note: R11.1 contract anchors outrank historical sections (R11-G00); within the Bible, §210.1 keeps the phase card above the corrective seal. The DsdSignalFormat additive extension (bit_order, organization) encodes real-format facts required by seals 211/212 and the F08/F10 consumer audit.

kinds.STATIC_FILE_STRUCTURE: produced only by the static parser from file bytes
kinds.RUNTIME_GST_CAPS: produced only by the deferred seal-212 isolated runtime probe; never emitted today

evidence_separation.rule: Static facts are typed and named (media_type/structure_fields/EvidenceKind) so no consumer can mistake them for runtime GStreamer caps evidence; runtime branch availability and DAC capability are never implied.
evidence_separation.structural_digest: length-prefixed, schema-versioned structural fingerprint (container + size + structural bytes) so same-name artifacts with different observed structures can never share indistinguishable evidence references; the FULL SHA-256 digest is the evidence authority (no truncation)

c2_notes.dsf_channel_type_5: FL+FR+FC+LFE per WavPack's DSD channel masks; FFmpeg's generic 4POINT0 maps the same type to FL+FR+FC+BC (documented divergence)
c2_notes.dsf_unknown_format_id: UNKNOWN, never COMPRESSED/UNSUPPORTED without positive compression evidence
c2_notes.dsf_file_size: declared total file size must equal the real size
c2_notes.dff_fver: must be the first chunk with an adopted supported version (0x01050000)
c2_notes.dff_prop: PROP form type must be SND; FVER/PROP/DSD multiplicity is exactly one
c2_notes.dff_cmpr: CompressionType + Pascal-string name validated (length and padding)
c2_notes.dff_dst: DST evidence (top-level DST/DSTI chunk) or a non-DSD CMPR codec is positively identified compression -> UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING; CMPR 'DSD ' combined with DST/DSTI evidence is contradictory structure -> UNKNOWN, never silently resolved
c2_notes.dff_channel_order: positions must match a normative ordered layout; unknown ids, duplicates or non-normative order fail closed
c2_notes.dff_singletons: FS/CHNL/CMPR children are required singletons; missing or duplicated required children fail closed (CONTAINER_UNKNOWN), as do a missing or duplicated DSD audio chunk
c2_notes.adversarial_bounds: hostile CHNL counts never allocate; non-regular paths are transient UNKNOWN; hostile chunk sizes fail closed without allocation
c2_notes.c2_final_seal: AP2-F07 audit after C2: residual review findings closed (full-digest authority, CMPR/payload contradiction semantics, singleton multiplicity, adversarial bounds, evidence-kind firewall test asserting this module never constructs EvidenceKind.RUNTIME_GST_CAPS)

format_authorities_cross_checked: FFmpeg libavformat/dsfdec.c (DSF chunk sizes include header; bits-per-sample 1=LSBF-planar, 8=MSBF-planar; channel table)
WavPack cli/dsf.c (DSF block math, channel masks, file size, sample count semantics)
WavPack cli/dsdiff.c and cli/dsdiff_write.c (DSDIFF 12-byte chunk headers with 64-bit sizes, FRM8 = file-12, PROP/SND children, DSD data size excludes header, MSB-first)
CoreAudio/sox cross-checks rejected where unavailable; no external code copied
external_validator_evidence: ffprobe (FFmpeg n9.0.2, independent implementation) recognizes the golden DSF fixture as format_name=dsf; the golden and builder DFF fixtures are independently imported end to end by the WavPack CLI (wavpack, exit status 0), a third independent DSDIFF reader implementation; DFF has no FFmpeg demuxer in this build.
claims_prohibited: GStreamer native DSD path is safe
